board: AM312 mini PIR motion sensor module (common 10 mm green board with white dome lens, 3 pins: VCC, OUT, GND)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test 'MOTION=1' with the motion toggle on, PCB DRC clean, footprint, LCSC C114881). Modelled as an active-high digital-sensor; the AM312 REL output is push-pull at the module's 3 V rail with a fixed ~2.3 s hold per the Senba datasheet.
breakoutPinoutSource: Vendor pinout VCC (pin 1), OUT (pin 2), GND (pin 3) from https://probots.co.in/am312-mini-pir-motion-sensor-module.html; OUT as the middle pin and the tiny +/- silkscreen confirmed at https://forum.mysensors.org/post/67494
